name: OpenMontage
description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.
one_liner: Turns your AI coding assistant into a full video-editing studio that can script, plan, edit, and produce videos from a text description.
buyer: A solo content creator or small marketing team that can't afford a video editor but needs a steady stream of short videos.
business_use_cases: A solo YouTuber describes a video in a prompt and gets a scripted, edited, captioned draft back.
A small e-commerce brand turns product photos and copy into short ad videos without hiring an editor.
An agency offers cheap 'AI-produced' video packages to small business clients.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a done-for-you monthly video production service for small businesses built on this pipeline.
Sell prompt/template packs tuned for specific video types (ads, explainers, social shorts).

steal_this: Launch a 'one video a day for a month' service for local businesses this weekend, using this as the production engine.
